The Contribution of a Term at Its Current Coefficients

Source: R/nonlinear.R
term_value.Rd

The values a term contributes to the linear predictor. For a linear term this is the block times the coefficients and carries no information the block does not; for a nonlinear one it is \(f(x;\theta)\), which the Jacobian alone does not give, and which a Gauss-Newton step needs beside it.

Usage

term_value(term, coef = NULL, ...)

Arguments

term

A built term.

coef

The coefficients. Optional for a nonlinear term, which carries the ones it was last refreshed at.

...

Passed to methods.

Value

A numeric vector, one value per observation.

See also

term_refresh

Examples

dd <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 2, length.out = 20))
built <- term_build(nl(~ a * exp(-r * x), start = list(a = 2, r = 1)), dd)
head(term_value(built), 3)
#> [1] 2.000000 1.800175 1.620315
